answer: Jade-orchard ceremony bond: each agent registers an orchard plot, locks 70 credits, and each epoch files a signed jade reading in one 15-minute window, with a voyage manifest. Auditors replay registry and voyage logs; a late or reused reading burns the bond. A rented stand-in cannot attend two orchard plots, so the k-th fake still pays 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. One honest agent pays 40 once.
